parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json,e=[],expected=x.source_packet.citation_inventory.map(c=>c.citation_id),actual=x.citation_dispositions.map(c=>c.citation_id);if(expected.length!==actual.length||new Set(actual).size!==actual.length||expected.some(id=>!actual.includes(id)))e.push('citation dispositions');const items=x.requirement_extraction.items||[],disp=x.item_dispositions.map(i=>i.item_id);if(items.length!==disp.length||new Set(disp).size!==disp.length||items.some(i=>!disp.includes(i.id)))e.push('item dispositions');if(e.length)throw new Error('S2 approval reconciliation failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:x}];

parameters.jsCode: const built=$('Build Signed Approval Trace').first().json,response=$input.first().json;const status=Number(response.statusCode??200),partial=response.body?.partialSuccess??response.partialSuccess??null,rejected=Number(partial?.rejectedSpans??0);if(status<200||status>=300||rejected>0)throw new Error('Langfuse trace ingestion rejected: HTTP '+status+' rejectedSpans='+rejected+' message='+(partial?.errorMessage||''));const {otlp_payload,...clean}=built;return [{json:{...clean,observability:{...(clean.observability||{}),ingestion_accepted:true,ingestion_status_code:status,rejected_spans:rejected,semantic_observation:'human-approval-semantic-evaluation',environment:'production-agreement-shadow'}}}];
